title: Clinical information
summary: Methods for organizing and interpreting information across clinical workflows.
description: This area examines how health information is represented, shared, and used by people making decisions in care settings.

title: Physiological signals
summary: Analysis of signals collected from clinical and everyday health devices.
description: This area studies signal quality, context, and interpretation across different sensing environments.

title: Digital systems
summary: Tools and interfaces designed around real clinical and research practice.
description: This area focuses on building systems that are understandable, maintainable, and useful to the people who rely on them.
